d:
Saoodi arab par huti hamlon ne kraun prins mohammad bin salman ke samne bari chunauti khari kar di hai. desh ki suraksha par uthte savalon ke bich unki mahatvakankshi 'vizan 2030' yojna ka bhavishy bhi mushkilon men ghirta dikh raha hai. videsh men rah rahe saoodi sarkar ke virodhi yuddh ko sanbhalne ke tariqe, ameriki madad aur turki-pakistan ke sath hue makka samjhaute par saval utha rahe hain. aakhir saoodi arab ki suraksha men kahan chuk huee? kya bare aayojnon aur aarthik mahatvakankshaon ke bich rashtriy suraksha pichhe chhut gaee? samjhie is riport men.
Riport: bibisi monitring
